learning_outcomes.text: Students understand the fundamental relationships of electromagnetism and can apply them to geometrically simple technical arrangements.
Students can analyze electrical circuits and systems when excited by sinusoidal alternating voltages in the steady state.
Students know the necessary relationships and mathematical methods and properties of AC technology.
Students can apply their knowledge to simple practically relevant problems.

syllabus_topics: Elementary methods for calculating magnetic fields
Energy, forces and moments in the magnetic field
AC circuits with sinusoidal excitation (time domain)
Complex AC calculation (topology of electrical circuits, analysis methods, transfer behavior)
Accompanying exercises for the lecture: deepening of teaching content, application of methods for field calculation and analysis of AC circuits to practically relevant tasks
Accompanying practical course for the lecture with special consideration of mechatronics
